globalThis.comparison = (() => {
  const variant = Number(globalThis.variant || 0);
  const scale = 0.75 + variant / 16;
  const result = {};
  globalThis.generatedGeometry = {};
  const before = '.target::before{content:"";display:block;height:12px}';
  const after = '.target::after{content:"";display:block;height:7px}';
  const check = (name, source, height, top, left=0) => {
    const target = document.createElement('div');
    target.className = 'target';
    target.id = 'target';
    const child = document.createElement('div');
    child.className = 'child';
    target.appendChild(child);
    document.body.appendChild(target);
    const sheet = document.createElement('style');
    sheet.textContent = ('/* variant '+variant+' */.target{width:100px}.child{width:10px;height:5px}'+source).replace(/(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)px\b/g,(_,value)=>Number(value)*scale+'px');
    document.head.appendChild(sheet);
    const box = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const inner = child.getBoundingClientRect();
    globalThis.generatedGeometry[name] = {height:box.height,top:inner.top-box.top,left:inner.left-box.left};
    result[name] = Math.abs(box.height-height*scale)<0.01 && Math.abs(inner.top-box.top-top*scale)<0.01 && Math.abs(inner.left-box.left-left*scale)<0.01;
    result[name+'Dom'] = target.childNodes.length===1 && target.firstChild===child && target.textContent==='' && target.querySelectorAll('*').length===1;
    sheet.remove();
    result[name+'Recovery'] = target.getBoundingClientRect().height===0;
    target.remove();
  };
  check('before', before,17,12);
  check('after', after,12,0);
  check('both',before+after,24,12);
  check('legacy',before.replace('::before',':before'),17,12);
  check('escaped',before.replace('::before','::be\\66ore'),17,12);
  check('upper',before.replace('::before','::BEFORE'),17,12);
  check('none',before+'.target::before{content:none}',5,0);
  check('normal',before+'.target::before{content:normal}',5,0);
  check('initial',before+'.target::before{content:initial}',5,0);
  check('unset',before+'.target::before{content:unset}',5,0);
  check('missing','.target::before{display:block;height:12px}',5,0);
  check('hidden',before+'.target::before{display:none;content:"text"}',5,0);
  check('strings','.target::before{content:"" "";display:block;height:12px}',17,12);
  check('specificity',before+'#target::before{height:18px}.target::before{height:2px}',23,18);
  check('important',before+'.target::before{height:18px!important}#target::before{height:2px}',23,18);
  check('order',before+'.target::before{height:18px}',23,18);
  check('mixed',before+'.target,.target::before{width:100px}',17,12);
  check('variables','.target{--size:18px}'+before+'.target::before{height:var(--size)}',23,18);
  check('localVariables','.target{--size:18px}'+before+'.target::before{--size:9px;height:var(--size)}.child{height:var(--size)}',27,9);
  check('variableContent','.target{--content:""}.target::before{content:var(--content);display:block;height:12px}',17,12);
  check('invalidVariable',before+'.target::before{content:var(--missing)}',5,0);
  check('layer','@layer a,b;@layer a{'+before+'}@layer b{.target::before{height:18px}}',23,18);
  check('media','@media all{'+before+'}',17,12);
  check('supports','@supports (width:1px){'+before+'}',17,12);
  check('host',before.replace('.target',':host,.target'),17,12);
  check('flex','.target{display:flex}.target::before{content:"";width:20px;height:8px}.target::after{content:"";width:30px;height:11px}',11,0,20);
  check('flexInline','.target{display:flex}.target::before{content:"";display:inline;width:20px;height:8px}',8,0,20);
  check('flexInlineBlock','.target{display:flex}.target::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:20px;height:8px}',8,0,20);
  check('padding',before+'.target::before{padding-top:3px;padding-bottom:2px}',22,17);
  check('relative',before+'.target::before{position:relative;top:7px}',17,12);
  check('descendant','.target ::before{content:"";display:block;height:12px}.child{height:auto}',12,0);
  check('childSelector','.target> ::before{content:"";display:block;height:12px}.child{height:auto}',12,0);
  check('grid','.target{display:grid}'+before.replace('display:block;','')+after.replace('display:block;',''),24,12);
  check('alternative','.target::before{content:"" / "alternative";display:block;height:12px}',17,12);
  check('invalidContent',before+'.target::before{content:invalid}',17,12);
  return result;
})();
